name: Virtual CVC
description: This algorithm allows the disting NT to be used as a virtual CVC (Control Voltage Converter) for the Haken Audio Continuum fingerboard. The disting NT's I2C address needs to be set to 0x28 in the Settings. The Continuum sends 16 output channels. Each one of these can be output to any of the disting NT's busses. Note that the signals from the Continuum don't just have to emerge directly from the module's outputs; they could just as well be the inputs to other algorithms.
